gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-alike-angular: Marker-bold and sunlit. Red Hat Display draws one steady stripe of ink for headlines that earn their keep big and short, while Alike Angular's serif stems run a touch heavier than its crossbars.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-almendra-sc: Dignified Almendra SC keeps its mouths open on c, e and a, while Red Hat Display holds one bold, marker-like line. One shouts crisply; the other settles in.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-alyamama: Red Hat Display's ink looks poured at a single width, with daylight in every curve. Headlines are where it hits hardest, whereas Alyamama's serif handles the quieter work with soft, light contrast between its verticals and curves.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ancizar-serif: Ancizar Serif has a bookish, gaping c at any size. Red Hat Display, rope-like in every stem and bowl, does the loud work up top, while this text serif keeps its stroke mild and approachable underneath.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-andada-pro: Red Hat Display bends its s curves like wire, never thinning at the spine. And Andada Pro's serif runs medium contrast without sharp hairlines, so a long stretch of it reads smoothly, with counters your eye slips through.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-antic-slab: Antic Slab brings round bowls with walls that never swell. Red Hat Display is best loud and bold up top, while this text serif does its dignified, editorial work in wide, barely curled s curves.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-arvo: Traditional and dignified, Arvo is a serif whose curves refuse to close, set under Red Hat Display's strokes cut like ribbon of constant width. Over a long passage it feels gently open.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-belgrano: Bold marker lines meet old-fashioned manners here: Red Hat Display draws a plain stripe of ink, then hands over to Belgrano. That classic serif keeps its curves open, so a long passage moves along easily.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-besley: No calligraphic shading anywhere in Red Hat Display, just a bold stripe of ink with daylight inside each curve. Besley, a text serif with a wide-open c and modest stem-to-hairline ratio, takes over below.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-biorhyme-expan: Red Hat Display bends its strokes like steel rod. Next to it, BioRhyme Expanded's text serif feels refined and bookish, with open gaps that let every letter stand apart.
